column1: This dataset includes the final identified list of acts that are likely to include Jim Crow laws from 1868 - 1968.
These acts were identified through a machine learning model and reviewed by Historical experts.
The data includes the number of the act, the data, the description or title of the act.
It also includes counties and topics identified by staff.
See White Paper for project description listed on the website at https://drsc.usccreate.org/otbsc/ .
